title: One-lane MOBA
summary: A League-style lane in three.js: fixed high-angle camera, click-to-move hero with four abilities on Q W E R, minion waves, towers, an AI enemy hero, health bars, a minimap and a kill feed. Every asset generated in code.
watchFor: Readability from above: can you tell units, lanes and towers apart?
Ability effects and sound (open it live)
Does the enemy hero behave like a player or a dummy?
Pathing: does the hero walk around things?
interaction: The same 60-second script for every build: press Play, click up the lane, cast Q W E R toward the enemy, fall back, push again.
